content.heading: development
content: My master repository where I develop software.
It contains various projects and configurations that power my personal website.
I work inside a WSL Ubuntu environment, with the development repository mounted as a devcontainer.

content.heading: From the README
content: The repo runs as a persistent Development Workstation Devcontainer for VS Code.
Ships the latest Git and GitHub CLI, bootstraps Node.js LTS via nvm, restores akinevz2/doftiles into ~/dots, and stows the bar, dunst, herbst, rofi, shell and vim packages with `stow --adopt`.
